Welcome to WEALTH BUILDERS INVESTMENT SERVICES

We are your one-stop multi-asset solution for all investment and wealth management needs. Our purpose is simple yet powerful to help individuals and families build sustainable wealth and achieve true financial freedom.

Founded with a vision to transform the way people invest, we focus on creatng personalized, transparent, and well-diversified financial strategies that empower our clients to grow, protect, and enjoy their wealth.

Transparency, trust, and long-term relatonships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that wealth is not built overnight but through disciplined planning, informed choices, and the right guidance at every stage of life.

Testimonials

Rekha Srinivas
Vaanija Associates, Hyderabad
★★★★★

We have known Mr. Ashish Modi for about 17 years now, as he serves us in the capacity of a financial advisor. We were first introduced to him during his stint at the firm Anand Rathi Brokerage and Financial Services post which he set up his own financial services firm Wealth Builders Investment Services and we have been his clients ever since.

Anurag Agarwal
Kolkata
★★★★★

At Wealth-builders, you can get your mutual funds curated according to your own financial goals and risk appetite. Mr. Ashish will typically discuss your investment horizon, assess and explain in detail the risk associated with the investment and then suggest suitable mutual funds, allocating the total capital in perfect asset classes which will enable a solid portfolio building and help in mitigating losses and creating wealth over time.

Harish Sahani
Hyderabad
★★★★★

Wealth Builders is true to its name. They really help you in building wealth in equities. Ashish Modi is experienced & dynamic. Really appreciate his inputs and guidance.

Harsh Wardhan Kandoi
Cuttack
★★★★★

When it comes to investment, think no further. A very practical approach to investment. Ashish Ji understands your goal and suggests the portfolios accordingly. His predictions have been spot on. He is a perfect mix of risk & reward.

Rahul Agarwal
Cuttack
★★★★★

Have been associated with Wealth Builders Investment Services since past 15 odd years now. The thing that I really like about Mr. Ashish is that he's a professional who is both an MBA and a CFA and not some random guy.

He understands markets and is in constant touch with fund managers and in tune with all ....

Rohaan Agarwal
Cuttack
★★★★★

Unlike other investment advisers at Wealth Builders, I actually got advice regarding investments. I made a couple of investments to test the waters and withdrew one of them out of desperation... the one which I held on to bore fruit. Looking forward for more advices.

Also, their app gives a handy report regarding all investments on the move and a lot more.

Creaseless (Abhinav Modi)
★★★★★

Wealth Builders, protects your money, suggests when to pull out & when to invest. Offers advice on the basis of the investor's requirement and risk-taking abilities. The best in the class.

Knowledge power house — Capital, Derivative market & mutual funds. The market movements are very well captured and conveyed to the investors.

The predictions are spot on — that is Wealth Builders for you.
